verdict.rationale: Convex schemas are defined in TypeScript (schema.ts) and are naturally version-controlled with the rest of the codebase; the CLI watches the filesystem and pushes new schema versions to the dev deployment (convex-docs-6, convex-docs-17), and other CLI commands like `convex run` and `convex import` support scripted/CI-style operations (convex-docs-18, convex-docs-26). However, there is no evidence of a dedicated migration system (versioned migration files, up/down migrations, migration history) or explicit documentation of a `convex deploy` command used in CI pipelines — schema changes appear to be pushed wholesale rather than tracked as discrete migrations. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD deploy workflow documentation, a formal migration-versioning/rollback mechanism, and evidence of production deploy commands distinct from dev push.
